description: This file appears to be a C++ source implementation for the RDKShell plugin. It contains include directives, class and function implementations, and code related to managing application lifecycle, system events, and client surfaces within the RDK platform. The code manages interactions with other system components via Thunder RPC, handles client activation/deactivation, and maintains internal state and event notifications.
